lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spatial distribution indicates a grid where inter-column distance is approximately 1.5x the intra-column distance between individual spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs to create a series of coordinate nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges exhibit a high-contrast vertical gradient (sharp luminance peak on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge) running longitudinally across the upper third of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with spot diameter decreasing toward the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small-diameter, high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more dispersed patterning on the main trunk.
